judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— We have heard Mr A. Arasu Ganeshan, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr Muniyapparaj, learned Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by Mr Sylvester John, learned counsel for the respondents.

2. The challenge is to an order of detention dated 4-6-2025, whereunder the detenu Shiek Abdhullah S/o. Beer Mohamed aged about 31 years, has been branded as a Goonda in terms of Section 3(1) of the Tamil Nadu Preventive Detention Act, 1982 (Tamil Nadu Act 14 of 1982) (in short “Act”).

3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor confirms the following facts:

(i) This is a solitary instance of a criminal case as against the detenu.

(ii) The date of arrest of the detenu is 17-5-2025.

(iii) Though the impugned order proceeds on the basis that there is every possibility of the detenu being enlarged on bail and this stand has been reiterated in the counter as well, there is no bail application that has been filed thus far and no documents have been produced indicating that such bail application would be moved.

(iv) As far as the averments in the counter that there is a similar case in Cr. No. 644 of 2024 where bail was granted to other accused by the Madras High Court in Crl.O.P. No. 30749 of 2024 dated 10-12-2024, admittedly that case is not related to the present matter and is not on similar terms.

4. In light of the aforesaid, there is no justification to sustain impugned order bearing memo No. 309/BCDFGISSSV/2025 dated 4-6-2025 and hence the same is set aside. This Habeas Corpus Petition is allowed and the detenu viz. Shiek Abdhullah S/o. Beer Mohamed, aged about 31 years, who is now confined in Central Prison, Puzhal, Chennai, is hereby directed to be set at liberty forthwith unless his presence is required in connection with any other case.
